t: Updated InvalidInputException error documentation to clarify that the service validates free-text field values against common cross-site scripting (XSS) patterns.

AWS Organizations now emits CloudTrail events (AccountJoinedOrganization, AccountDepartedOrganization) to the management account for membership changes, including join and departure method and timestamp.
Updates close Account quota for member accounts in an Organization.
Added Path field to Account and OrganizationalUnit objects in AWS Organizations API responses.
Updated the CloseAccount description.
Add support for policy operations on the NETWORK SECURITY DIRECTOR POLICY policy type.
Add support for policy operations on the S3_POLICY and BEDROCK_POLICY policy type.
Add support for policy operations on the UPGRADE_ROLLOUT_POLICY policy type.
Added new APIs for Billing Transfer, new policy type INSPECTOR_POLICY, and allow an account to transfer between organizations
Added Account State field to the ListDelegatedAdministrators API response.
Update endpoint ruleset parameters casing
Documentation updates for AWS Organizations APIs.
This release introduces 2 new APIs in Organizations: 1. ListAccountsWithInvalidEffectivePolicy 2. ListEffectivePolicyValidationErrors
Add support for policy operations on the SECURITYHUB_POLICY policy type.
Added ALL_FEATURES_MIGRATION_ORGANIZATION_SIZE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED to ConstraintViolationException for the EnableAllFeatures operation.
Add support for policy operations on the DECLARATIVE_POLICY_EC2 policy type.
Add support for policy operations on the Resource Control Polices.
Add support for policy operations on the CHATBOT_POLICY policy type.
Doc only update for AWS Organizations that fixes several customer-reported issues
Releasing minor partitional endpoint updates.
Added a new reason under ConstraintViolationException in RegisterDelegatedAdministrator API to prevent registering suspended accounts as delegated administrator of a service.
This release contains an endpoint addition
Documentation update for AWS Organizations
Doc only update for quota increase change
Documentation updates for permissions and links.
This release introduces a new reason code, ACCOUNT_CREATION_NOT_COMPLETE, to ConstraintViolationException in CreateOrganization API.

This release introduces delegated administrator for AWS Organizations, a new feature to help you delegate the management of your Organizations policies, enabling you to govern your AWS organization in a decentralized way. You can now allow member accounts to manage Organizations policies.
This release adds the INVALID_PAYMENT_INSTRUMENT as a fail reason and an error message.
This release provides the new CloseAccount API that enables principals in the management account to close any member account within an organization.
Minor text updates for AWS Organizations API Reference
